name: ATLAS D / Pressure Boundary Study

pressure_hull.note: Gross geometric envelope, not usable accommodation volume; closed mesh is not pressure qualification. Ports, trunks, wall and reinforcement are arrangements only.

simulation: 42-second kinematic illustration, not a dynamic simulator or real dive duration
limitations: No pressure shell scantlings or material grade
Upper pavilions must be flood-compatible and unoccupied during dives
No validated buoyancy, stability, hydrodynamics, power or life support sizing
Hatch interlocks are software teaching examples, not safety-rated controls
